steps.title: Canvas Quiz Test
steps.content:
Canvas Quiz Test

This is a temporary test lesson. Start the quiz to try the canvas drawing question type.

Students will be asked to draw something on a canvas, submit it to Google Drive, and then vote on each other's submissions.

quizQuestions.q: Draw a monster of your own invention! 👾
Draw a scene from your favourite film or TV show! 🎬
Draw what you can see out of your nearest window! 🪟
Draw a map of a made-up place! 🗺️
Draw a weather scene — sunshine, storm, snow, or something stranger! ⛈️
Draw an alien and their planet! 👽
Draw your favourite sport or hobby! ⚽
Draw a logo for an imaginary company! 🏷️
Draw a vehicle of the future! 🚀
Which of these is a mammal?
